decisions.rationale: Same narrowing as the accepted React decision: each increment claims only the specific requirement fragments it teaches, checks, applies and publicly tests (for example 'collections#o2 (read and update)'). Compound objectives are marked partially covered and owned by their topic pages and quizzes. Remove any blanket full-coverage claim. No syllabus, calendar or minute changes.

Define deterministic per-increment selection: while working on increment N, a documented command runs only increment N's public tests (for example python -m pytest -q tests/increment_N). Before completion, the cumulative command runs increments 1..N. Late-entry verification uses uncommitted private checkpoints with 1..N-1 complete, the same model as the accepted html-css-js decision. Remove the promise that an unfinished learner gets a passing full run.
